entries.12920a9863c970e7: It is the group's core business, engaged in real estate brokerage and related operations. entries.151522da842c0e04: While conservatively assessing the risks of external environmental impacts, the company states that it aims to achieve sustainable growth and a high-profitability structure by continuing to pursue its strategy of maximizing synergies from its one-stop system.
